_comment: Every visible or assistive string in the shared chrome, per locale. Copied VERBATIM from the current live pages — see docs/SHARED_CHROME_MIGRATION.md for the source of each. Do not reword: these are the live site's strings.

home.emptySeason: This season’s events are being planned — the first will appear here soon.

_ariaPatternComment: {name} is substituted with the member's FULL name. Until Phase 5 it was a per-member stored string that was usually just a first name, which gave the two members called Maksymilian the identical accessible name "Email Maksymilian" on the same page. Using the full name removes that collision and lets the patterns be applied uniformly. See docs/TEAM_ACCESSIBILITY_REMEDIATION.md.

pl.logoAlt: Logo Federacji Polskich Stowarzyszeń Studenckich w Wielkiej Brytanii

footer.orgName: Federacja Polskich Stowarzyszeń Studenckich w Wielkiej Brytanii
footer.blurb: Organizacja charytatywna zarejestrowana w brytyjskiej Charity Commission, zrzeszająca polskie stowarzyszenia studenckie na uczelniach w Wielkiej Brytanii. Przez studentów. Dla studentów.
footer.copyright: © 2026 Federacja Polskich Stowarzyszeń Studenckich w Wielkiej Brytanii. Organizacja charytatywna zarejestrowana w Anglii i Walii.

pl._teamComment: The aria patterns below were English until Phase 5 — a real defect that made a Polish screen reader announce every one of the 42 contact links in English. They are now Polish. The colon construction is deliberate: 'do' and 'profil' would otherwise require the genitive ('do Szymona'), which cannot be produced from an uninflected name, so a label:value form is used instead. See docs/TEAM_ACCESSIBILITY_REMEDIATION.md §7.
pl._announcementsComment: Transcribed verbatim from the live pl/announcements.html — the card call-to-action, the closed-registration chip, the modal's aria-label and its close button. extraImageAltPattern reproduces the existing derived alt text; {n} starts at 2 because the main image is photo 1.
pl._membersComment: Transcribed verbatim from the live pl/members.html. Unlike the team page (see the aria note above), the Polish society cards were already correctly localised — both the visible labels and the aria-labels.
pl._contactComment: Labels on the initiative sub-links. Instagram, LinkedIn and Facebook are brand names and stay untranslated on the live Polish page; only 'E-mail' and 'Strona' differ.

home.emptySeason: Wydarzenia tego sezonu są w przygotowaniu — pierwsze pojawią się tutaj wkrótce.
